versions.content: Naming convention shall be unique Type: valid Description: Naming conventions must state clear and deterministic rules for the creation of names such that names can be uniquely determined from signal characteristics. Rationale: 1) Support distributed development 2) Avoid definition of redundant signals since different developers will create names by application of the same rules. 3) Avoid misuse of signals. 4) Enable consistency checks and tool-based processing of names. 5) Enhance readability since all developers / users of the names develop the same mindset. Use Case: -- Dependencies: [RS_SWMG_00002] Name shall reflect the purpose of the model element,
